dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregularly elliptical 'O' and 'C' shaped structures concentrated in the mid-dorsal region; perimeters consist of high-contrast dark borders with sharp gradient transitions to lighter interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid dark-pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily interspersed between larger macro-annuli in the anterior and lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent mid-dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse triangular configuration with the long axis oriented longitudinally.
